title: Vow and Orchard
author: Wendell Yarrow
blurb: Jonah Pemberton, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
